
## Demo — weather-forecast seller (end to end)
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/developer-kit/bnbchain-studio/demo/

Walkthrough for the BNB Agent Studio demo that follows a weather-forecast seller example on BSC testnet: install the CLI, scaffold the agent in an AI IDE, create a wallet, fund it, activate an LLM, negotiate a sale, register on-chain, and deploy.

Commands and behavior reference the [bnbagent-studio](https://github.com/bnb-chain/bnbagent-studio) repository; see its [weather seller example](https://github.com/bnb-chain/bnbagent-studio#-example-a-weather-forecast-seller-end-to-end) for the canonical README.

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Notes |
|-------------|-------|
| Python ≥ 3.10 | CLI and runtime library |
| Claude Code, Cursor, or another AI IDE | Studio is driven via skills + natural language |
| Node.js ≥ 20 + AgentCore CLI | Required for `bag init`, `bag dev`, `bag deploy agent` |
| A wallet password you choose | Never committed to git; kept in `WALLET_PASSWORD` env only |

## 1. Installation

Open the [bnbagent-studio](https://github.com/bnb-chain/bnbagent-studio) repo in your AI IDE and ask it to install workspace packages. For a one-line production install, use `pip install bnbagent-studio` — see [Quickstart](quickstart.md).

Install the AgentCore CLI with `npm install -g @aws/agentcore` and install studio skills with `bag skills install --target both --scope user`, then reload your IDE.

## 2. Start vibe coding

Describe the agent you want — for example, a default BNB Chain seller with ERC-8183, ERC-8004, and x402 wired in. The scaffolding skill inspects `bag init` and the recipes before recommending a setup.

Example init command for the walkthrough:

```bash
uv run bag init weather-seller \
  --llm-provider pieverse-llm \
  --network bsc-testnet \
  --storage-provider local \
  --no-auto-topup
```

- `--llm-provider pieverse-llm` — enables x402 in the payment section.
- `--network bsc-testnet` — safe testnet defaults.
- `--storage-provider local` — uses local storage instead of Pinata.
- `--no-auto-topup` — lets you control when the wallet is funded.

Init creates a two-layer workspace: `app/agent/` and `app/service/`.

## 3. Wallet setup

`bag init` creates an encrypted keystore at `.studio/wallets/`, outside `app/agent/`. Set `WALLET_PASSWORD` in a separate terminal session so it never appears in the AI tool chat context.

```bash
cd ~/Desktop/weather-seller/app/agent
echo "WALLET_PASSWORD=<your-password>" >> .env.local
set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a
uv run bag wallet new
```

The command outputs a public wallet address and updates `[wallet].address` in `app/agent/studio.toml` plus `[provider].address` in `app/service/studio.toml`.

## 4. Fund the wallet

Activate the default Pieverse `auto/free` LLM — no deposit is required:

```bash
uv run bag llm activate
```

For gas, get tBNB from the [BSC Testnet Faucet](https://www.bnbchain.org/en/testnet-faucet).
